question:
A 57-year-old patient undergoes colonoscopy, revealing an 8 mm sessile serrated polyp with dysplasia
located near the cecum. Following the polyp's resection, what is the appropriate surveillance schedule?
Answer Choices: (A) Repeat colonoscopy in 2 years (B) Fecal immunochemical testing annually (C)
Repeat colonoscopy in 3 years (D) Repeat colonoscopy in 5 years (E) Repeat colonoscopy in 6 months
(F) CT colonography every 2 years (G) Repeat colonoscopy in 10 years (H) Repeat colonoscopy in
5-10 years (I) Repeat colonoscopy in 7-10 years (J) Repeat colonoscopy in 12 months
 A. Fecal immunochemical testing annually
B. Repeat colonoscopy in 6 months
C. Repeat colonoscopy in 12 months
D. Repeat colonoscopy in 5-10 years
E. Repeat colonoscopy in 2 years
F. Repeat colonoscopy in 10 years
G. Repeat colonoscopy in 3 years
H. Repeat colonoscopy in 5 years
I. Repeat colonoscopy in 7-10 years
J. CT colonography every 2 years
